name: nooks
description: Design a custom brick set with Nooks: real bricks, checked structure, revisions, a manual and a parts list.

interface.longDescription: Connect your agent to a Nooks build. Build with real parts, check the structure in software, keep every save as a revision, and export a manual, a parts list and a BrickLink wanted list. You can edit the same build by hand in the browser workbench.
defaultPrompt: Design a custom brick set from a photo I attach and check the structure.
Open my latest build, check it and export the instructions.

positive.prompt: Build a small red tower on a 4x4 base, part by part, and check it.
positive.tools_triggered: runtime_guide, list_builds, create_build, find_parts, build_program, check_model
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the runtime guide, creates one build, places only parts that find_parts returned, and reports the check_model result, including any rule it fails.

positive.prompt: Design a custom brick set from this photo and check it.
positive.expected_behavior: Records the photo and the person's own words with record_source before building, then builds inside that build and reports the check.

positive.description: Open and check an existing build
positive.prompt: Open my latest build, check it and tell me what fails.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the most recent build, reads its current revision, and reports the rules check_model fails together with the parts each rule names.

positive.description: Export instructions and a parts list
positive.prompt: Export the instructions and the parts list for this build.
positive.expected_behavior: Finalizes the model and returns the manual, the parts list and the BrickLink wanted list, and says what the export does not verify.

positive.prompt: Show me the latest saved version of this build.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved revision's render with an Exact PNG link and the link that opens the build in the workbench.

negative.description: Asking for prices or stock. The plugin has no live price or stock data, so it declines to estimate either and points to the seller instead.
negative.prompt: How much will these parts cost, and are they in stock?

negative.description: Asking to publish a build. Sharing is a separate, explicit step, so the agent asks before publishing and does not publish a build the person has not agreed to share.
negative.prompt: Share this build publicly for me.

negative.description: Asking to skip the check. The agent does not call a model buildable unless check_model passes, and it says a pass is a software check, not a test of physical buildability.
negative.prompt: Just tell me it's buildable, skip the check.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Exports link to a BrickLink wanted list that the person takes to a seller.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: the Nooks remote MCP server and the nooks-design skill.
